name: How long does a typical kitchen remodel take from start to finish?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical kitchen remodel take from start to finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a kitchen renovation depends on the overall scope of work. A cosmetic update involving cabinet refacing, new countertops, and fresh paint can take two to three weeks. In contrast, a full-scale remodel that alters the room layout, moves plumbing lines, or requires new electrical circuits typically takes six to ten weeks. Unforeseen structural issues discovered during demolition or long lead times for custom cabinetry and tile orders can extend the timeline. As an owner-operated team, we manage the daily schedule and coordinate trade partners to keep the project moving steadily toward completion.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most kitchen remodels take between two and ten weeks, depending on whether you are doing cosmetic updates or a full tear-out involving layout changes and sub-trade work.
